RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the July 30, 2003/Sravana 8, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
Operation to flush out ultras in J&K
*141. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
DR. AKHILESH DAS:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether security forces in Jammu
and Kashmir have launched a drive to flush
out ultras from mountain hide-outs in J&K;
and
(b) if so, the number of ultras  captured
or killed in the operation and the arms and
ammunition seized from their hide-outs, and
the number of Indian security personnel
who laid down their lives during the
operation?
FIRs through e-mail
*142. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Union Government is
considering any proposal which will enable
police stations to receive FIRs through
e-mail from the citizens thereby bringing in
transparency in the citizen-police interface
in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it is likely to be implemented?
Funds for Sector Reforms Scheme
*143. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA:
SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have stopped
releasing funds for the Sector Reforms
Scheme which was started  a few years
back as a  pilot project for supplying
drinking water to the rural areas;
(b) if so, the details  thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps proposed  to be taken to
revive the scheme at an early date?
Terrorist incidents in J&K
*144. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether terrorist incidents  have
increased  in Jammu and Kashmir during
the last two months;

44
WS-3\C-SESSION\1800RS 44
(b) if so, whether  army camps and
innocent people in Jammu and Kashmir
have become again the targets of terrorist
activities; and
(c) the new strategy which Government
plan to adopt to counter these activities?
Activities of terrorist organisations
†*145. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that terrorist
organisations like 'Khalistan' have recently
vowed to increase their activities;
(b) if so, whether Government have
requested the concerned State
Governments to give details in this regard;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the action
the Central Government are contemplating
to take in this regard?
Amarnath pilgrimage
†*146. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of pilgrims from various
parts of the country who registered
themselves for the Amarnath pilgrimage as
also the number of persons out of them
who could have darshan of Amarnath;
(b) what arrangements Government of
India  have made for their security and in
regard to catering facilities  for the pilgrims
during their pilgrimage;
(c) the amount of money incurred by
the Government; and
(d) whether number of  Amarnath
pilgrims  this year was less as compared to
that of last year?
Reservation policy for ex-servicemen
in Government and PSUs
*147. SHRI SHANKAR ROY
CHOWDHURY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the reservation policy for
ex-servicemen for jobs in all Government
and Public Sector Undertakings is being
implemented strictly; and
(b) whether Government are considering
the formation of a "National Ex-
Servicemen's Commission" to monitor the
implementation of Government policies for
ex-servicemen in the Central  as well as
State  Government Undertakings?
Power generation in  Tenth Plan
*148. SHRI VAYALAR RAVI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether private sector's poor
performance  in power sector has forced
the Government to take steps with the
States to improve the power  generation in
Tenth Plan;
(b) if so, whether  Centre  has decided
to formulate  policy  guidelines for granting
multiple  distribution licence under New
Electricity Bill;
(c) if so, the main features thereof;
(d) what has been the actual capacity
addition upto June 15, 2003, in thermal and
hydro fields; and
(e) the steps Centre proposes to take
to set certain  portion for production by
private  sector during the Tenth Plan?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Joint patrolling at Indo-Bangladesh
border
*149. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether BSF and Bangladesh Rifles
have jointly agreed for patrolling along the
Indo-Bangladesh border;
(b) if so, whether  the modalities for
joint patrolling  have been worked out; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Declaration of "Deendar Anjuman" as
unlawful association
*150. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the July 30, 2003/Sravana 8, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—150

Losses incurred by collieries in
Government sector
†1027. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH ‘LALAN’:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that collieries under
Government sector are constantly running
in losses;
(b) if so, the total amount of loss to these
collieries during the years 2000-2001,
2001-2002 and 2002-2003; and
(c) the capital investment made by the
Government in collieries industry till 2003
alongwith the loan amount due by these
collieries?
Capacity utilisation by coal washeries
†1028. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH ‘LALAN’:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that coal washeries
are being run in Government sector in the
country;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the total number of coal
washeries by March, 2003 and their total
production capacity;
(c) whether it is also a fact that these
washeries have operated at less than their
capacity during years 2000-2001,
2001-2002 and 2002-2003; and
(d) if so, the percentage of utilization of
their installed production capacity each year?
Recruitment in coal sector
1029. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any embargo on
recruitment in coal sector;
(b) whether it is a fact that for years
casual workers are being engaged; and
(c) if so, the action Government have
taken to regularise the casual workers after
stipulated 240 days?
Steps to boost loss making subsidiaries
of C.I. L.
1030. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
the loss making subsidiaries of Coal India
Ltd. (CIL);

225
WIN2\1692\1802RS 225
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, what are those subsidiaries and
the loss sustained by them each, annually
during last three years; and
(c) the steps taken to improve the
performance of loss making coal
companies?
Investigation into accident at Murpar
Coal mines
1031. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Singareni Collieries Ltd.
has made investigation into the accident on
28th January, at Murpar Coal mines;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether proper compensation
has been provided to the victims of
accident;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor;
(f) whether any officer has been found
guilty during the enquiry; and
(g) if so, the action taken against these
officials?
Co-operation in mining with foreign
countries
†1032. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the countries with which agreements
for co-operation have been arrived at for
mining rare commodities like 'slates' in
Himachal Pradesh;
(b) the benefits derived by the State as a
result thereof; and
(c) the details of the co-operation by India
with other countries in mining?
Production of clean coal
†1033. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI :
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Central Government is
going to introduce a pilot project to make
clean coal (coal with zero pollution);
(b) if so, whether this project will be
launched in Bihar;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Illegal occupation of staff quarters of
South Eastern Coalfields
1034. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a member of
Legislative Assembly is occupying a
number of staff quarters at Birsiughpur
Colony of Johila area under South Eastern
Coalfields;
(b) if yes, the number of quarters under
his occupation with date of occupation of
each;
(c) whether any penal rent is being
realised from the occupant;
(d) if yes, the amount thereof; and
(e) if no, the reasons therefor?
Operation "Sarp Vinash" in J&K
1035. SHRI SHANKAR ROY
CHOWDHURY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Intelligence agencies
provided adequate, accurate, and timely
information about the existence of militant
bases in the Hill Kaka region of Jammu and
Kashmir;

226
WIN2\1692\1802RS 226
(b) whether there was inordinate delay
in acting on the information so provided to
launch operation for clearance of the areas
(Operation Sarp Vinash); and
(c) whether it is a fact that large number
of militants have dispersed from the Hill
Kaka region to establish similar bases in
other areas of Jammu and Kashmir,
especially Doda-Kishtwar?
MiG-21 crash in Barmer district
Rajasthan

RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be

(a) whether a MiG-21 aircraft of Indian
